DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW3_BrewPotions_Description:
<emphasis>Brew 5 Slurp Potions</>.

Count Brickula's legend talks about him sending people to their "eternal sleep," that's actually a translation error. He's really treating people to "eternal Slurp," which is a lot less menacing. Combine <emphasis>Slurp Mushrooms</>, <emphasis>Deft Milk</>, and <emphasis>Glass</> at a <emphasis>Potions Cauldron</> to brew a <emphasis>Slurp Potion</>.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW1_CatchFish_Description: Catch 3 Jellyfish or Cuddle Fish. Nothing relaxes me like staring blankly into the haunting, fathomless, absolutely crushing beauty of the deep. And nothing says 'Brick or Treat' like swiping a couple fish out of their homes! Jellyfish can only be caught in the ocean near The Shore, while Cuddle Fish are found everywhere!
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW3_CraftCharmOfReturn_Description:
<emphasis>Craft a Charm of Return.</>

My final batch of creepy quests are celebrating the vamp champ himself! Count Brickula is a Brick or Treat icon and the KING of comebacks. Literally! He comes back from the dead each night to continue his unending reign of throwing fantastic parties. Some say it's a curse that he returns to life, but real ones know he's just really crafty. Why don't you try it for yourself?
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW2_DefeatSkeletons_Description:
<emphasis>Defeat 10 Skeletons.</>

My bones are RATTLING with excitement. It's time for the SKELEBRATION! What's got the head of a giant skele-tiger, with the body of an EVEN GIANTER SKELE-SERPENT? Calcitor! The ultimate bonehead! It's said that Calcitor's Jaws are the entrance to a cave that grants wishes AND always has great wifi reception. Let's kick off the Skelebration by observing some Skeletons up close.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW2_DefeatSkeletonWolves_Description:
<emphasis>Defeat 5 Bone Wolves.</>

Did I ever tell you why we have so many skellies here? It all started with Minnie Figman. Originally a witch who got put on trial, Minnie Figman won her lawsuit so hard, it made magic mandatory for everyone. Turns out, most people aren't so good at magic, and they accidentally summoned a bunch of skeletons that rise each night. It really got out of hand when the wolves started rising, too.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW2_GatherClaws_Description:
<emphasis>Gather 10 Wolf Claws.</>

When you think about it, claws are the teeth of the feet. And what are teeth? Bones! The Skelebration continues!
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW1_CraftGemRod_Description:
Craft a <emphasis>Gem Fishing Rod</> at a <emphasis>Crafting Bench</> using <emphasis>Wolf Claws, Drawstring, Wooden Rods, and Cut Gems</>.

Our Brick or Treat quests begin with a celebration of the tentacled, nightmarish legend of the deep! <emphasis>THE KRAKEN</>! The beast lurks in the darkest seas, dragging entire ships down to the depths! Oooo, my bones are shaking, it's so elegantly beautiful! We'll need a <emphasis>Gem Fishing Rod</> worthy of sharing the seas with its monstrous magnificence.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW3_DefeatGolem_Description: Defeat a Golem from the Lost Isles or an Oni Stonebreaker on NINJAGO Island. Count Brickula's Crypt aesthetic is best described as "creepy stone decor that may or may not move when you turn your back." To get some inspo for building his crypt, I'm sending you on a quest to get up close and personal with a rock monster.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW3_DefeatGolem_ShortDescription: Defeat a Golem or Oni Stonebreaker
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW3_GatherMats_Description:
Gather <emphasis>Granite Slabs, Planks, Mahogany, and Sandstone</> to build the <emphasis>Count Brickula's Crypt</> decoration.

Your Brick or Treat questing has paid off! You've uncovered the secret to building Count Brickula's Crypt and soon, you can get some well-earned eternal rest. Use a <emphasis>Stone Breaker</> to make <emphasis>Granite Slabs</>, A <emphasis>Lumber Mill</> to make <emphasis>Planks</>, A <emphasis>Gem Cutter</> to make <emphasis>Cut Ruby</>, A <emphasis>Stone Breaker</> to make <emphasis>Sandstone</>, gather <emphasis>Mahogany</> from the <Klo>Lost Isles</>, and find <emphasis>Vines</> anywhere.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW1_GatherMats_Description:
Gather <emphasis>Obsidian Slabs, Glass, Wooden Rods, and Vines</> to build <emphasis>The Kraken</> decoration.

Beautiful, mysterious, tentacle-y. Now all you need are the right ingredients... <emphasis>Obsidian Slabs</> from a <emphasis>Stone Breaker</>, <emphasis>Glass</> from a <emphasis>Smelter</>, <emphasis>Wooden Rods</> from a <emphasis>Lumber Mill</>, and find <emphasis>Vines</> anywhere.
DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW2_GatherMats_Description: Gather Obsidian, Mahogany, and Marble Slabs to build the Calcitor's Jaws decoration. You've done it! You've uncovered the recipe to build all the pieces of Calcitor's Jaws! Now all you'll need are the materials to build it! Gather Mahogany from the Lost Isles. Gather Obsidian from the Dry Valley. Use a Stonebreaker to make Marble Slabs.

DT_JunoIconMold_Journal_Tasks.IMW1_CraftBaitBuckets_Description:
Use a <emphasis>Mixer</> to make 3 <emphasis>Bait Buckets</>.

<emphasis>TRICK!</> Now you've got to get the grossest goop. Hehehe-- it's not Brick or Treat without Tricky Treater tricking you with a trick or two!
